# FEAGI MCP tool index (part 2 of 2)

Part 2 of 2. Other parts: [tool-index.md](tool-index.md).

## Value planes and classifiers

- `list_classifiers()`: List first-class genome classifiers.
- `inspect_classifier()`: Inspect one classifier assembly in a single call.
- `create_classifier()`: Create a classifier with its memories, answer areas, and answer modulators.
- `update_classifier()`: Update a classifier record.
- `wire_value_passthrough()`: Wire a one-layer value plane 1:1 so each voxel's potential arrives exactly.
- `validate_magnitude_passthrough()`: Check that graded magnitudes in `src_area` reach `dst_area` unchanged.
- `expand_value_to_bins()`: Create a `W x H x levels` bin area driven by a one-layer value plane.
- `decode_class_map()`: Decode the last burst of a one-layer class map into class ids.
- `measure_audio_io_disparity()`: Measure the live gap between an audio input area and its audio output.

## Activity, stimulation, and neurons

- `probe_area_response()`: Force-fire one cortical area and measure whether a downstream area responds.
- `stimulate_area()`: Stimulate a cortical area for testing.
- `stimulate_area_batch()`: Stimulate many voxels in one cortical area in a single request.
- `run_stimulus_protocol()`: Present a timed stimulus sequence and record per-burst firing in one call.
- `hold_stimulus()`: Hold voxels of one area firing on every burst for `duration_s` seconds.
- `get_stimulus_hold()`: Outcome of a `hold_stimulus` hold (state, posts, `landed` check), or list holds.
- `schedule_stimulus()`: Force-fire voxels at exact burst offsets, inside the burst loop (no wall-clock jitter).
- `cancel_stimulus()`: Cancel the entries of a `schedule_stimulus` schedule that have not fired yet.
- `get_stimulus_schedule()`: Active `schedule_stimulus` schedules: ids, burst range, remaining entries, next burst.
- `record_spikes()`: Burst-exact firing of up to 64 areas over the next `bursts` bursts.
- `analyze_run()`: Acceptance metrics from a spikes CSV, as compact JSON (never rows).
- `monitor_activity()`: Monitor real-time neural activity, plus lifetime fire-count enrichment.
- `monitor_activity_batch()`: Monitor multiple cortical areas concurrently.
- `get_fire_queue_detailed()`: Get last-burst fire queue with neuron IDs per cortical area.
- `get_sensor_snapshot_last()`: Latest sensory input decoded by the burst loop (`/v1/input/sensor_snapshot/last`).
- `get_motor_snapshot_last()`: Latest motor output produced by the burst loop (`/v1/output/motor_snapshot/last`).
- `list_area_neuron_states()`: Compact neuron rows for one area: x/y/z, membrane potential, fire count.
- `inspect_neuron_state_at()`: Neuron runtime state at a voxel (`/v1/connectome/neuron_properties_at`).
- `get_neuron_state_by_id()`: Neuron runtime state by stable id (`/v1/connectome/neuron/{id}/properties`).
- `get_voxel_neurons()`: All neurons + synapses at a voxel (`/v1/cortical_area/voxel_neurons`).

## Burst engine

- `get_burst_engine_status()`: Get burst engine runtime status.
- `get_burst_engine_config()`: Burst engine config (`/v1/burst_engine/config`).
- `get_burst_counter()`: Current burst counter (`/v1/burst_engine/burst_counter`).
- `control_burst_engine()`: Burst engine control (`POST /v1/burst_engine/control`).
- `pause_burst_engine()`: Hold (pause) the burst engine (`POST /v1/burst_engine/hold`).
- `resume_burst_engine()`: Resume the burst engine after a hold (`POST /v1/burst_engine/resume`).
- `set_burst_engine_frequency()`: Set the running brain's burst frequency. This call is the whole change.

## Agents and embodiment

- `get_registered_agents()`: Get list of all registered agents and their subscriptions (agent registry).
- `get_agent_liveness()`: How close each registered agent is to being deregistered for inactivity.
- `get_agent_properties()`: Get detailed properties for a specific registered agent.
- `get_motor_group_summary()`: Compact motor bundle titles, unit ids, and channel counts for an agent.
- `get_agent_joint_map()`: Get a focused actuator-to-OPU mapping for a registered agent.
- `get_agent_device_registrations()`: Get device registrations for an agent showing motor/sensor structure.
- `list_agent_capabilities_all()`: Raw multi-agent capabilities payload (`/v1/agent/capabilities/all`).
- `compare_device_registration_store()`: Compare session vs descriptor device-registration stores (compact).
- `get_agent_connection_endpoints()`: Get the live FEAGI agent connection endpoints (ZMQ/WebSocket) and burst rate.
- `send_motor_command()`: Drive a specific robot joint to a target angle/position via OPU stimulation.
- `auto_polarity_probe()`: Empirically discover OPU column -> sensor direction by force-firing each column.
- `list_controller_bridges()`: List all active controller bridges (xARM, MuJoCo, ROS2, etc.) discovered on this machine.
- `get_embodiment_status()`: Get status of connected embodiment controllers (GET /v1/embodiment/status when available).
- `embodiment_discover_introspection_endpoint()`: Locate a controller's introspection HTTP endpoint via the launcher descriptor.
- `embodiment_get_physics_state()`: GET ground-truth physics state from an embodiment controller.
- `embodiment_measure_bodies()`: Read tilt, height and contacts of named bodies from the MuJoCo controller (read-only).
- `embodiment_set_joint_state()`: Place embodiment joints deterministically (e.g. tilt pendulum, position arm).
- `embodiment_reset_episode()`: Reset the simulated embodiment to a named keyframe, or to the model default.
- `embodiment_reset_simulation_time_stats()`: Reset the session max simulation clock (benchmark high-water mark).
- `measure_balance()`: Balance outcome numbers from the simulator: episodes, upright time, tilt, falls.
- `record_aligned_trace()`: One timeline pairing each sampled burst with the simulator's physics at that moment.

## MuJoCo scene and simulator packs

- `get_mujoco_scene_config()`: Read the live MuJoCo settings: safety boundary, objects, cameras, embodiment, feedback, rate.
- `configure_mujoco_scene()`: Apply one MuJoCo settings action on the running controller.
- `add_mujoco_scene_object()`: Add one primitive to the running MuJoCo scene without removing the others.
- `set_mujoco_safety_boundary()`: Turn the Cartesian safety box on or off in the running MuJoCo scene.
- `composer_list_simulator_packs()`: Query Composer public catalog of shared simulator asset packs (GCS-backed).
- `composer_get_simulator_pack_versions()`: List semver versions indexed for `pack_id` on Composer.
- `composer_get_simulator_pack_resolved()`: Resolved pack manifest with per-file HTTPS URLs (include.xml, LICENSE, etc.).
- `composer_download_simulator_pack_bundle()`: Download every file listed in the resolved manifest into `output_directory`.

## Brain Hub block datasheets

- `get_block_datasheet()`: Read a Brain Hub block release's datasheet (`feagi.datasheet/1`) from Composer.
- `check_port_contract()`: Check one live area against one datasheet port row; per-check pass/fail with numbers.

## Brain Visualizer API pass-through

- `list_brain_visualizer_operations()`: List every Brain Visualizer REST operation (operation_id, method, path, description).
- `brain_visualizer_api()`: Invoke any whitelisted Brain Visualizer FEAGI API operation.

## Studio-only tools (neurorobotics-studio server; present only when Studio is connected)

- `read_design_notebook(view?, kinds?, since?, query?, limit?)`: the experiment's design notebook; the default view is a digest of goal, constraints, baseline, open hypotheses, dead ends and recent entries.
- `append_design_note(kind, title, body?, metrics?, status?, refs?, amends?, tags?)`: adds one entry (goal, constraint, baseline, hypothesis, change, measurement, verdict, dead_end, idea, gap).
- `save_brain_snapshot(label, note?)`: pins a named snapshot of the running experiment: genome saved to the experiment in Composer (team-aware), connectome kept locally and uploaded in lite form asynchronously.
- `export_run_data(run_id, destination?)`: exports a recorded run's data after re-hashing every file against its manifest.
- `list_brain_snapshots(experiment_id?)`: the experiment's named snapshots with saved-by, counts and sync state.
- `preview_block_datasheet(working_genome_id)`: previews a block's datasheet in Studio for a working genome; read-only, nothing is published.
- `set_block_datasheet_draft(working_genome_id, datasheet)`: writes the author and measured datasheet fields into the working genome's draft in Studio; nothing is published.
- `package_region_for_hub(region_id, title?, ports{inputs,outputs}, datasheet?, form?)`: Persist-tier; raises a Studio approval the user must accept. Writes a region copy with ports to the account and opens Publish (form fills it in); publishes nothing.
- `prepare_hub_release_form(working_genome_id, form)`: Persist-tier; raises a Studio approval listing every form value. Opens Publish on an uploaded working genome with the form filled in; the user accepts the terms and presses Publish; publishes nothing.
- `restore_brain_snapshot(label | checkpoint_id, experiment_id?)`: reverts the genome and reloads the connectome. Destructive; changes the shared brain for a team.
- `get_run_window_stats(plan_id, execution_id?, cell_ids?, windows, areas?, fields?)`: per-attempt window stats (falls, steps RMS, neuron state at window end, firing rate) from a Trainer run data folder. Use `analyze_run` for spike-timing/ring/phase metrics.
